name: Shackleton Crater region
description: Candidate exploration region near the lunar south pole encompassing elevated crater rim terrain and adjacent permanently shadowed regions (PSRs).
provenance: NASA Artemis III Candidate Landing Regions / IAU Lunar Gazetteer (Shackleton crater center 89.9°S, 0.0°E; rim elevation features up to 89.65°S).

name: Malapert Massif
description: High-altitude massif (~5 km elevation above surrounding terrain) on the South Pole-Aitken basin rim, offering favorable Earth line-of-sight visibility and periods of extended solar illumination.
provenance: NASA Artemis Candidate Landing Regions / LROC LOLA topographic studies (~85.99°S, 357.07°E / -2.93°E in East-positive system).

name: Connecting Ridge
description: Prominent upland ridge feature connecting Shackleton crater toward de Gerlache and Henson craters, identified as a candidate region balancing solar accessibility and volatile prospecting proximity.
provenance: NASA Artemis III Candidate Landing Region Studies (~89.44°S to 89.53°S, 209.95°E to 222.7°E / -137.3°E in East-positive system).

name: Nobile Crater region
description: Highland terrain and ancient crater rim region prioritized for surface volatile investigation, near the prime landing area evaluated for VIPER and Artemis science objectives.
provenance: NASA Artemis III Candidate Landing Regions (Nobile Rim 1/2) & VIPER Landing Site Studies (~85.28°S, 37.8°E in East-positive system).
